import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from pipeline import import_batch, resume
from reducer import empty_state
from checkpoint import dump_state
from codec import parse_event


class ImporterIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.st = empty_state()

    def test_end_to_end_workflow(self):
        lines = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}',
            '{"id":"r2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":5}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3],["B",2]]}',
            '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}',
        ]
        st = import_batch(self.st, iter(lines))
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['A'], 10)
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['B'], 5)
        self.assertNotIn('Q', st['requests'])
        self.assertEqual(set(st['seen']), {'r1', 'r2', 'v1', 'c1'})
        # input state unchanged
        self.assertEqual(self.st['stock'], {})

    def test_empty_batch_detached_equal(self):
        st = import_batch(self.st, [])
        self.assertEqual(st, empty_state())
        st['stock']['X'] = 1
        self.assertNotIn('X', self.st['stock'])

    def test_failed_batch_leaves_state_unchanged(self):
        lines = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",2]]}',
            '{"id":"v2","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",9]]}',  # fails
        ]
        before = deepcopy(self.st)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_batch(self.st, iter(lines))
        self.assertEqual(self.st, before)
        self.assertEqual(self.st['seen'], {})

    def test_failed_parse_leaves_state_unchanged(self):
        lines = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}',
            '{not json',
        ]
        before = deepcopy(self.st)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_batch(self.st, iter(lines))
        self.assertEqual(self.st, before)

    def test_restart_equivalence(self):
        all_lines = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}',
            '{"id":"r2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":5}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3],["B",2]]}',
            '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}',
            '{"id":"v2","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",4]]}',
        ]
        uninterrupted = import_batch(self.st, all_lines)
        final_checkpoint = dump_state(uninterrupted)

        # Stop after event 2, checkpoint, restart, finish remaining.
        half = import_batch(self.st, all_lines[:2])
        cp = dump_state(half)
        restarted = resume(cp, all_lines[2:])
        self.assertEqual(restarted, final_checkpoint)

        # Byte-identical final checkpoint text.
        loaded = resume(cp, all_lines[2:])
        self.assertEqual(loaded, final_checkpoint)

    def test_replay_after_restart(self):
        # Workflow replays old events after restart (event ids reused).
        all_lines = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",2]]}',
            '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}',
        ]
        full = import_batch(self.st, all_lines)
        # replay of old events after restart must produce same state
        replayed = import_batch(deepcopy(full), all_lines)
        self.assertEqual(replayed, full)

    def test_reordered_split_lines_replay_exact(self):
        # Split reserve lines canonicalize identically to combined.
        first = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":20}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",2],["A",3]]}',
        ]
        second = [
            '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":20}',
            '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3],["A",2]]}',
        ]
        st1 = import_batch(self.st, first)
        st2 = import_batch(self.st, second)
        self.assertEqual(st1, st2)
        self.assertEqual(st1['requests']['Q'], {'A': 5})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
